sourceAttempts.result: Confirms Richter / Neal Road as a year-round WDFW access site with a concrete ramp and parking.
USGS 12149000 near Carnation supplies direct Snoqualmie River discharge telemetry for the valley corridor.

sourceAttempts.method: Fall City to Tolt-MacDonald reach and public boat launch review
sourceAttempts.result: Mountaineers and local route documentation identify an approximately 11-mile Class I Fall City-to-Tolt confluence paddle; King County documents Tolt-MacDonald Park's public boat launch, parking and seasonal campground. Plum-to-Tolt and Neal-to-Tolt retain Fall City or Neal as intermediate bailout options.

thresholdEvidence.reachApplicability: Snoqualmie Falls–Fall City–Neal Valley corridor. American Whitewater identifies about 467 cfs as low runnable and documents beginner floats plus higher-flow reports around 1,100–1,600 cfs. Verify live 12149000 telemetry, trend, recent rain, wood, weather and access notices before travel.

endpointAudit.reviewNote: Plum, Neal and Tolt endpoints are documented ramp or water-entry locations and receive the audit's expected review classification for access-edge offsets. The Fall City endpoint is the documented river-entry trail below SR-202; no endpoint is suspicious or failed. Plum-to-Tolt and Neal-to-Tolt retain intermediate bailout options.
